description: Paid routes require a funded Base USDC wallet. Use readfetch-client / @readfetch/client or the MCP signing proxy (@readfetch/mcp-x402-proxy). Direct calls without a signing client will stop at 402. Run a web search without a separate search API subscription. Returns titles, URLs, and snippets only — not full page text; follow with readfetch_text, readfetch_probe, or readfetch_scrape on a chosen result URL. `limit` is 1–20 (default 5). Optional `lang` biases locale (e.g. en, de-DE). Optional `tbs` filters recency: h= past hour, d= day, w= week, m= month, y= year. Use readfetch_map/readfetch_crawl when you already know the site; readfetch_* URL tools when you have the link.

lang.description: Optional language/locale hint, e.g. en or de-DE.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 5).

tbs.description: Optional recency filter: h=hour, d=day, w=week, m=month, y=year.

name: readfetch_search
